With \(B=(-1,0)\), \(C=(1,0)\), and \(A=(0,\sqrt3)\), the trisection points are
\[
D=\left(-\frac13,0\right),\qquad E=\left(\frac13,0\right).
\]
Thus
\[
\overrightarrow{AD}=\left(-\frac13,-\sqrt3\right),\qquad \overrightarrow{AE}=\left(\frac13,-\sqrt3\right).
\]
Their dot product is
\[
\overrightarrow{AD}\cdot \overrightarrow{AE}
= -\frac19+3=\frac{26}{9}.
\]
Also,
\[
|\overrightarrow{AD}|^2=|\overrightarrow{AE}|^2=\frac19+3=\frac{28}{9}.
\]
So
\[
\cos(\angle DAE)=\frac{\frac{26}{9}}{\frac{28}{9}}=\frac{13}{14}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\sin(\angle DAE)=\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{13}{14}\right)^2}
=\sqrt{\frac{27}{196}}
=\frac{3\sqrt3}{14}.
\]
Thus \(a=3\), \(b=3\), \(c=14\), and
\[
a+b+c=20.
\]
\[
\boxed{20}
\]
